{{Quote|That armor has a special healing mechanism. It heals any wound. They just got it working when Valon stole it!|An Imperial engineer|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
A set of experimental '''regenerative armor''' was found during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] among the debris of one of the numerous crashed [[Starship/Legends|starships]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. The armor could bring its wearer to life from near-death conditions. After studying the armor, the Empire gave it to the [[White Maw]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Valon (pirate)|Valon]], instructing him to carry out strikes against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. However, Valon became too independent and planned to use the armor to become the leader of the entire White Maw organization. The Captain was stopped by the [[The Barsen'thor|Barsen'thor]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], who broke the armor by repeatedly inflicting serious injury to Valon.
